notes: Customer credit transactions/payments (own, LINK_FLAG=0): type filter/default, legacy numbering, customer/date checks, receipt books, pay method with allocation to invoices (1 oldest first, 2 invoice picker, 4 none), totals and residual, account link, GL posting buttons (APP_RULES_AR / APP_ACT_AR, see processes/ARCRTRN.md)

rules.where: TRNS_ID in (select ID from AR_TRNSTYPE where EFFECT = 1 and TRNS_TYPE not in (5, 6) and nvl(TOT_TRNS_FLAG, 0) = 0) and TRNS_SERIAL_TOT is null and nvl(LINK_FLAG, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (TRNS_ID in (select TRNS_ID from AR_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD where FLAG = 1 and PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and CUSTOMER_ID in (select CUSTOMER_CODE from AR_CUST_PASSWORD where PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and SALESMAN_ID in (select SALESMAN_CODE from AR_SALESMAN_PASSWORD where PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))))

key_expr.AR_MAINTRNS.CTGRY_CODE: case when v('REQUEST') in ('CREATE', 'SAVE') then app_rules_ar.default_ctgry(:new.trns_id, :new.customer_id) end
key_expr.AR_MAINTRNS.SALESMAN_ID: case when v('REQUEST') in ('CREATE', 'SAVE') then app_rules_ar.default_salesman(:new.trns_id, :new.customer_id, :new.ctgry_code) end

info.name: CREATOR
info.sql: select app_rules_ar.user_name(create_user_code) from ar_maintrns where rowid = chartorowid(:PAGE_ROWID)

AR_MAINTRNS.PAY_METHOD.label_a: طريقة الدفع (1 تنازلي على الفواتير / 2 شاشة مساعدة للفواتير / 4 مبلغ دائن لعميل)
AR_MAINTRNS.PAY_METHOD.label_e: Pay method (1 descending on invoices / 2 helping invoice screen / 4 debit sum for client)

AR_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ID.lov: select id || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(description_e, description_a) else description_a end d, id r from ar_trnstype where effect = 1 and nvl(tot_trns_flag, 0) = 0 and trns_type in (3, 4) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from ar_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by id

AR_MAINTRNS.CTGRY_CODE.lov: select category_type_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(category_type_desce, category_type_desca) else category_type_desca end d, category_type_code r from st_category_type order by category_type_code

AR_MAINTRNS.SALESMAN_ID.lov: select code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, code r from salesman where code in (select salesman_code from ar_cust_salesman where ctgry_code = :PAGE_CTGRY_CODE and customer_code = :PAGE_CUSTOMER_ID) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or code in (select salesman_code from ar_salesman_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by code

AR_MAINTRNS.BOOK_SERIAL.lov: select b.book_serial || ' (' || b.from_serial || ' - ' || b.to_serial || ')' d, b.book_serial r from ar_salesman_books b where b.salesman_code = :PAGE_SALESMAN_ID and nvl(b.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and nvl(b.book_finsh, 0) = 0 and nvl(b.book_type, 0) = 1 order by b.book_serial

AR_MAINTRNS.COST_CODE1.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(cost_desc_e, cost_desc) else cost_desc end d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or cost_code in (select p2.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by cost_code

AR_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by account_number

AR_MAINTRNS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by account_number

AR_MAINTRNS.DISC_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by account_number

AR_MAINTRNS_ACCOUNT_DET.TRNS_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select p2.account_number from ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by account_number

AR_MAINTRNS_ACCOUNT_DET.COST_CODE1.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(cost_desc_e, cost_desc) else cost_desc end d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or cost_code in (select p2.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE))) order by cost_code

AR_MAINTRNS.MAINAREA_NAME.sql: (select max(a.name_a) from ar_mainarea a where a.id = t.mainarea_id)

AR_MAINTRNS.SUBAREA_NAME.sql: (select max(s.name_a) from ar_subarea s where s.main_id = t.mainarea_id and s.id = t.subarea_id)

AR_SUBTRNS.INV_TRNS_DATE.sql: (select max(s.inv_date) from ar_subtrns s where s.trns_id = t.inv_trns_id and s.trns_serial = t.inv_trns_serial and s.mainarea_id = t.inv_mainarea_id and s.subarea_id = t.inv_subarea_id and s.bill_seq = t.inv_bill_seq)

AR_SUBTRNS.INV_TOTAL_VALUE.sql: (select max(s.total_value) from ar_subtrns s where s.trns_id = t.inv_trns_id and s.trns_serial = t.inv_trns_serial and s.mainarea_id = t.inv_mainarea_id and s.subarea_id = t.inv_subarea_id and s.bill_seq = t.inv_bill_seq)

AR_SUBTRNS.INV_RESIDUAL_VALUE.sql: (select max(s.total_value - ar_subtrns_payed_value(s.trns_id, s.trns_serial, s.mainarea_id, s.subarea_id, s.bill_seq)) from ar_subtrns s where s.trns_id = t.inv_trns_id and s.trns_serial = t.inv_trns_serial and s.mainarea_id = t.inv_mainarea_id and s.subarea_id = t.inv_subarea_id and s.bill_seq = t.inv_bill_seq)

AR_SUBTRNS.TOTAL_VALUE_RIYALH.sql: nvl((select max(m.currency_rate) from ar_maintrns m where m.trns_id = t.trns_id and m.mainarea_id = t.mainarea_id and m.subarea_id = t.subarea_id and m.trns_serial = t.trns_serial), 0) * nvl(t.total_value, 0)

params.name: INVOICE
params.lov_sql: select s.bill_id2 || '/' || s.bill_id1 || ' - ' || to_char(s.inv_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' (' || to_char(app_act_ar.bill_open('ARCRTRN', s.trns_id, s.mainarea_id, s.subarea_id, s.trns_serial, s.bill_seq), 'FM999G999G990D00') || ')' d, s.trns_id || ':' || s.mainarea_id || ':' || s.subarea_id || ':' || s.trns_serial || ':' || s.bill_seq r from ar_subtrns s join ar_maintrns m on m.trns_id = s.trns_id and m.mainarea_id = s.mainarea_id and m.subarea_id = s.subarea_id and m.trns_serial = s.trns_serial where m.trns_id in (select id from ar_trnstype where effect = 0) and m.customer_id = to_number(:PAGE_CUSTOMER_ID) and app_act_ar.bill_open('ARCRTRN', s.trns_id, s.mainarea_id, s.subarea_id, s.trns_serial, s.bill_seq) > 0 and app_act_ar.in_payment(:PAGE_ROWID, s.bill_id1, s.bill_id2) = 0 order by m.trns_date, s.bill_id1, s.bill_id2

params.label_a: المسدد شامل الخصم (فارغ = الأقل من المتبقي بالسند والفاتورة)
params.label_e: Amount incl. discount (empty = the smaller open value)

actions.name: TOGGLE_COMM
actions.label_e: Commission on / off for a line

params.name: LINE
params.lov_sql: select s.bill_seq || ' - ' || s.bill_id2 || '/' || s.bill_id1 || ' - ' || case when nvl(s.without_comm_flag, 0) = 1 then 'بدون عمولة' else 'بعمولة' end d, s.bill_seq r from ar_subtrns s, ar_maintrns m where m.rowid = chartorowid(:PAGE_ROWID) and s.trns_id = m.trns_id and s.mainarea_id = m.mainarea_id and s.subarea_id = m.subarea_id and s.trns_serial = m.trns_serial order by s.bill_seq
